intro: Tai'jin is a Darkspear troll priest trainer stationed within the barracks of Razor Hill in Durotar. She guides fledgling priests of the Horde, introducing Darkspear initiates to traditional troll rites such as the Hex of Weakness.

p: Stationed inside the sturdy barracks of Razor Hill, Tai'jin serves as a spiritual mentor for young priests stepping out into Durotar. While orcs predominantly turn to shamanism or dark warlock arts, the Darkspear trolls bring their own distinct communion with the spirits and loas to the Horde. Tai'jin offers foundational teachings in the priesthood, ensuring that new acolytes understand both the balance of light and shadow and the spiritual heritage unique to troll culture.
